On April 9, NCCS researcher [Sajana](../../team/sajana/sajana.html) successfully defended her PhD (thesis titled *Individual differences in cochlear compression reveal incipient cochlear changes in normal-hearing adults*).
She is now a PhD graduate from the University of Texas at Austin.
Soon she will come with the news of her postdoc journey. Stay tuned. ;) 

Congrats Dr. Sajana! 🎉
